title: BODY PANEL ANTI–CHIPPING PAINT APPLICATION AREAS
ocr_text:
AR-10                    ANTI–RUST TREATMENT

BODY PANEL ANTI–CHIPPING PAINT APPLICATION AREAS

HINT:
1.    Anti–chipping paint should be applied to some areas before the second coat and to others after the
      top coat.

2.    If other areas are accidentally coated, wipe of the paint immediately with a rag soaked in a grease,
      wax and silicone remover.

: Soft–Chip Primer (body front)

: PVC Chipping Primer (outside rocker panel)

: Chipping Protector (plastic)
